initiative.name: TypeScript → Rust Migration (night-agent-runner)
initiative.objective: Port the night-agent-runner TypeScript/React/Ink CLI application to idiomatic Rust across six crates (tui, cli, core, plugins, integrations, remote), achieving behavioral parity and passing all Nx verification targets in apps/agent-runner-rust.

teammates.name: analyzer
teammates.objective: Analyze all TypeScript source files in apps/night-agent-runner/src/ and produce a per-file migration analysis with subsystem classification, IO contracts, migration risk, and recommended Rust target crate. Broadcast findings before any porter begins work.

teammates.name: porter-tui
teammates.objective: Port the tui-repl subsystem (screens/, components/, ink/, hooks/, dialogLaunchers.tsx, interactiveHelpers.tsx, ink.ts, replLauncher.tsx) to Ratatui/Crossterm in the night-agent-runner-tui crate.

teammates.name: porter-cli
teammates.objective: Port the command-surface subsystem (commands/, commands.ts, cli/, entrypoints/) to Clap/Tokio in the night-agent-runner-cli crate.

teammates.name: porter-core
teammates.objective: Port the runtime-core and session-compaction subsystems (QueryEngine.ts, query.ts, query/, assistant/, services/, state/, bootstrap/, context/, history.ts, tasks/, tools/) to Tokio async in the night-agent-runner-core crate.

teammates.name: porter-extensions
teammates.objective: Port the skills-and-plugins, mcp-integrations, and remote-connectivity subsystems (skills/, outputStyles/, services/mcp/, bridge/, remote/, server/) to their respective Rust crates (plugins, integrations, remote).

teammates.name: verifier
teammates.objective: Progressively verify each ported crate for behavioral parity as porters complete their slices. Run rust-migration-verifier on each crate, report pass/fail to the lead, and block the acceptance gate until all crates pass.

doneCriteria: rust-migration-verifier reports PASS for all six crates: tui, cli, core, plugins, integrations, remote
cargo check and cargo test pass for the full apps/agent-runner-rust workspace
All Nx typecheck, test, and build targets pass for apps/agent-runner-rust (pnpm exec nx run-many -t typecheck,test,build --projects=agent-runner-rust)
No unanalyzed TypeScript files remain in apps/night-agent-runner/src/ (analyzer confirms 100% coverage)
